lines.quote: Designed and validated adaptive beamforming algorithms for a 16-element receive phased array used in the company’s S-band ground terminal product.
Wrote embedded DSP firmware in C++ for the KW-400 wideband receiver’s real-time channeliser module, targeting an ARM Cortex-R5 processor under hard 8 µs loop constraints.

Built and maintained the signal processing group’s Python test infrastructure (~12 000 lines, pytest-based with CI integration), including a nightly hardware-in-the-loop regression suite covering three receiver variants.

Ran RF front-end calibration using Keysight PNA-X network analysers and R&S FSW spectrum analysers; prepared calibration data packages for two customer antenna characterisation campaigns in the company’s anechoic chamber.
MSc Applied Physics (YDIT, 2021) — thesis on electromagnetic wave propagation in stratified dielectric media, with application to radar return modelling and remote-sensing retrieval algorithms.
I have some familiarity with Kalman filtering and estimation theory
Contributed to range compression and azimuth focusing routines for the IceView airborne SAR payload’s ground-segment signal processor.
Contributor to the open-source SigProc-DSP library on GitHub (160+ stars); authored the frequency-domain beamforming module and two merged pull requests to SciPy’s sparse-array interface.
Work conducted under Finnish residence permit (type A, valid through 2028; EU work authorisation unrestricted).
All project documentation and design reviews at Sumuvire Wireless conducted in English.
Familiar with the Oulu engineering community and open to relocating.
